about: Phase 7 (prompts/phase-07-analysis.md step 2): components and closeness on a graph with more than one piece. `analysis::components::weak` and `::strong` must give every node its own component where nothing connects it, numbered in ascending dense-index-of-first-member order, not discovery order. `analysis::centrality::closeness` must stay finite and well-defined per node without ever dividing by an unreachable count (Wasserman & Faust's disconnected-safe form) — a node with no reachable neighbour scores exactly 0, not NaN or infinity.

strong_components.why: a->b is directed: no path back from b to a, so they are separate strong components even though one weak component joins them; c-d is undirected, so it is one strong component the same as it is one weak component

closeness.why: z has no incident edge at all: 0 reachable nodes, so closeness is defined as exactly 0.0, never a division by zero
